title: PledgeSubmission
description: What the homepage pledge form submits. Query-param names match property names; qty arrives as a string in GET and is coerced to a number. Pledge number (n) is server-assigned and NOT submitted — the comp fakes it client-side only.

who.description: Handle / nickname. Trim whitespace before validating.

type.description: Detail option; allowed values depend on kind (see allOf).

qty.description: Gigabytes for ram/usb, disk count for floppy. Form floor is 1; values below 1 (e.g. 0.1 for a 128MB stick) are accepted by the feed but the form clamps to min 1.

eulogy.description: Optional eulogy for the media. Empty string or omitted both mean none.

theme.description: Mail-kit theme slug. Maps to pages: classic -> mailkit-b-zine.html, ramageddon -> theme-ramageddon.html, warhammer40kb -> theme-warhammer40kb.html, gondor -> theme-gondor.html. NOTE: the current comp dropdown submits page filenames and has no name attribute — adopting this schema means switching it to submit the slug.

examples.eulogy: she served 11 years in my ThinkPad
